reviews.text: Purchased my second bottle. It’s a good product to remove the makeup without the sting. This easily remove makeup but not good with mascaras.
reviews.zh: 已經買咗第二支。係一支卸妝唔會刺痛嘅好產品。輕鬆卸到妝，不過對睫毛液就唔太得。

reviews.text: Very effective and soothing cleansing water for skin BUT beware on the eyes. It stings so would only recommend for skin and lip makeup removal. I saturate it with a cotton pad to remove foundation/sunscreen/lip makeup.
reviews.zh: 對皮膚嚟講係非常有效而且舒緩嘅卸妝水，但係用喺眼周要小心。會刺眼，所以只建議用嚟卸面部同唇部彩妝。我會用化妝棉沾濕佢嚟卸粉底、防曬同唇妝。

reviews.text: i was honestly surprised at how fragrance-free it was. i love that it removes sunscreen and makeup effectively plus its gentle on the skin, so i felt no irritation at all! this will be great product if you want a lighter cleansing overall ☘️
reviews.zh: 我真係好驚喜佢係完全無香味。鍾意佢可以有效卸防曬同化妝，之餘又溫和唔傷皮膚，所以完全冇刺激感！如果想整體清爽少少嘅清潔，呢支會係好選擇 ☘️

reviews.text: If you want a light, soothing cleanser that’s kind to skin — especially sensitive or oily types — beplain’s Mung Bean Cleansing Water is a solid everyday pick. It keeps skin feeling clean without dryness, though it’s best paired with a deeper cleanser when you’re wearing full makeup.
reviews.zh: 如果想搵一支輕柔、舒緩又對皮膚好嘅潔膚水——特別係敏感肌或者油性肌——beplain 綠豆卸妝水係一個穩陣嘅日常選擇。佢可以保持皮膚乾淨又唔會乾燥，不過如果你化咗全妝，最好配搭一支清潔力更強嘅潔膚產品一齊用。

reviews.text: For a cleansing water, the cleaning power is great. it removed my heavy makeup well. There is not really a scent, so it is not irritating. The only thing is it stings the eyes a bit, but the sensation ends quickly after wiping away. I would say for drier skin it might not be as moisturizing, so make sure to include a moisturizer in your routine.
reviews.zh: 作為一支卸妝水，清潔力真係好強，可以卸得走厚重妝容。基本上冇乜香味，所以唔會刺激。唯一係會有少少刺眼，不過抺完之後感覺好快就消失。對乾性肌嚟講可能保濕度唔夠，所以記得喺程序入面加返保濕。

reviews.text: I use this every morning. Micellar waters usually break me out but this stuff doesn’t. Makes my skin feel so refreshed and ready for the rest of my skincare
reviews.zh: 我每朝都會用。卸妝水通常都會令我爆瘡，但呢支就唔會。用完皮膚感覺好清新，可以準備做之後嘅護膚程序。

reviews.text: This is my favorite cleansing water! I use it as my second cleanser in the morning, it’s not drying or irritating and you don’t have to rinse it off.
reviews.zh: 呢支係我最鍾意嘅卸妝水！我喺朝早用佢做第二支潔膚產品，唔會乾燥或者刺激，而且唔使過水。

reviews.text: I feel a little bit dry, squeaky when using it.
reviews.zh: 用完覺得有少少乾、繃緊。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
